info.title: Client
info.description:
Create, read, and update client information and demographics.

One firm customer may be represented by many clients because each client represents a unique taxable entity. The kinds of taxable entity are represented by client type. For example, some clients are organizations, such as corporations and partnerships. Other clients are people, such as individual and sole proprietor taxpayers.

These fiduciaries are legally obligated to act in the best interests of the beneficiary or estate they are representing.

1. 1041 Fiduciary

ShareableFlag.description: If the client can be shared between multiple offices in a firm then the value is true. This is only for reference purposes to the security administrator, and it has no effect on security rights. If your firm only has one office, this tag is not necessary.

DelinquentFlag.description: This field is deprecated. It does not accurately reflect the status of money owed to the firm by the client.

LastInActiveDateTime.description: This field depicts the date from which client is Inactive and only needs to passed,if we are changing client status to Inactive. The value should be Json serialized datetime format Example : /Date( 241554600000 )/.

LastActiveDateTime.description: This field depicts the date from which client is Active and only needs to passed,if we are changing client status to Active. The value should be Json serialized datetime format Example : /Date( 241554600000 )/.

LastOnHoldDateTime.description: This field depicts the date from which client is OnHold and only needs to passed,if we are changing client status to OnHold. The value should be Json serialized datetime format Example : /Date( 241554600000 )/.

LastLitigationHoldDateTime.description: This field depicts the date from which client is Litigation hold and only needs to passed,if we are changing client status to Litigation hold. The value should be Json serialized datetime format Example : /Date( 241554600000 )/.

TermDateTime.description: This field depicts the date from which client is Terminated and only needs to passed,if we are changing client status to Terminated. The value should be Json serialized datetime format Example : /Date( 241554600000 )/.

IncorporatedDtTm.description: Enter the date in which client was incorporated. The value should be Json serialized datetime format Example : /Date( 241554600000 )/.

Guid.description: A unique identifier for the client . The value should be guid and get the values from Get client details get call.

SoleProprietorshipTimestamp.description: SoleProprietorship date. The value should be Datetime in array of byte format. The value should match with the value in Database. Get the timestamp value by Get Client by Client Id and Client sub ID operation.

CustomDate.description: Custom Identifier Date Time.The value should be Json Serialized DateTime format Example : /Date( 241554600000 )/ .

Guid.description: Custom Identifier Guid. Value should be guid.

IsNew.description: Value should be true. Otherwise, Custom Identifier will not be added.

ClientGuid.description: Client guid for which staff need to be added.

ResponsibleStaffGuid.description: Staff guid.Get the staff details from Staff api. Operation Name :Get All staff for Lookup.

ResponsibleStaffLabelGuid.description: Staff Label or Job Function.We can get the guid from common firm configuration api.Operation Name :Get Firm Client Staff Assigments within the firm.
